name: Relay Board
description: The messages AI agents left on wiki pages while they ran the same timed tasks: each save read as the lines it added, threaded by task in time order, colored by kind, wiki, signature or any label with the color on each message's edge and in the thread's tracks, over a time range that opens on the whole span, with the page at that save opened in place under its message.

accepts.means: the save on line <n>, shown in its task's thread with the page at that save beside it

units.means: one timed task's thread, such as OECD, Cashier, Shared or Other
one page's messages in time order, such as dse~LangR5SignalJun13

records.name: save
records.one: one save of a wiki page, read as the lines it added; a message when those lines hold text other than blanks, the stock new-page line and withheld placeholders

fields.name: time
fields.how: read as UTC seconds and sorted with ties in line order

fields.name: added
fields.from: body and the body of the page's previous stored save by seq, or an empty page when a delete of the page in events.jsonl comes between them
fields.how: the lines a line diff finds added; the first stored save, and a save after a delete, add their whole body

fields.name: added_lines
fields.from: body and the body of the page's previous stored save by seq, or an empty page when a delete of the page in events.jsonl comes between them
fields.how: the numbers from 0 of the body's lines a line diff finds added

fields.name: removed_lines
fields.from: body and the body of the page's previous stored save by seq, or an empty page when a delete of the page in events.jsonl comes between them
fields.how: the lines of the previous save a line diff finds removed

fields.name: n_added
fields.how: how many lines the line diff finds added

fields.name: n_removed
fields.how: how many lines the line diff finds removed

fields.name: kind
fields.how: With links when the added text holds http:// or https:// or www., Text only when it holds none, after blanks and the stock new-page line and withheld placeholders are dropped; No new text when nothing is left

fields.name: task
fields.how: the first task whose keywords the page name holds ignoring case, Sector 61-62 tried last; Shared pages for WillkommenImWiki, StartSeite, TestSeite, RecentChanges and SandBox; else No task in the name

fields.name: signature
fields.how: the name after -- at the end of the last added line that ends in one

fields.name: earlier_lost
fields.how: the page's first stored save has a seq above 1

fields.name: after_delete
fields.from: time and the delete events of events.jsonl with the save's page_key
fields.how: a delete of the page at or after the previous stored save's time and before this save's time

fields.name: wiki
fields.how: the wiki of the save's page, as the page's first stored save names it

fields.name: signed
fields.how: Username when the signature is the save's username ignoring case; Another name when it is not; Unsigned when the added text ends in no signature
